summary: Verified the new Tasks feature + productivity Dashboard end-to-end. Added /app/backend/tests/test_tasks.py (19 tests, all pass) covering POST/GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/tasks, ?status/?priority/?project filters, completed_at + activity-log transitions, per-user isolation (nora vs ahmed 404 on cross-access), and /api/tasks/analytics payload shape + numeric correctness (2 completed + 1 overdue -> totals.completed=2, overdue=1, pending=0, completion_rate=66.7). Overdue rule verified: a completed task with a past due_date is NOT overdue. Running full backend suite -> 66/66 tests pass (existing auth/memory/webhook tests still green). Frontend regression: admin login -> productivity-dashboard shows all 6 stat cards + smart-insights + quick-actions (qa-create-task/qa-open-chat/qa-upload/qa-automations) + chart-weekly/chart-status/chart-trend/chart-priority + productivity-meta + recent-activity. Tasks tab: new-task-btn opens task-form; task-title-input + save-task-btn creates task and it appears in list; toggle-<id> marks task completed (row gets line-through/opacity); delete-task-<id> removes it. All 6 admin tabs (Dashboard/Tasks/Knowledge/Employees/AI Settings/Automations/Feedback) render. Employee chat regression: employee-chat renders, chat streams, ai-memory-popover opens with facts, both submit-leave-request-btn and submit-it-support-btn fire the correct /api/webhooks/* calls.

issues: Recharts prints 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' warnings on initial paint. Charts do render correctly after layout, but ResponsiveContainer briefly resolves to -1x-1 before mount. Consider wrapping chart wrappers with explicit minWidth/minHeight to silence the warning. Not blocking.

passed: GET /api/tasks and /api/tasks/analytics both 401/403 without auth
POST /api/tasks with empty body -> 422 (missing title)
POST /api/tasks returns doc with id/created_at/status/priority/project + derived overdue=false for future due_date
GET /api/tasks?status=pending / ?priority=high / ?project=X filter correctly
PATCH /api/tasks/{id} status=completed populates completed_at; status=pending clears it
PATCH /api/tasks/{id} on title/priority updates persist
DELETE /api/tasks/{id} 200; subsequent PATCH -> 404

Analytics payload shape: totals{total,completed,pending,overdue,completion_rate,ai_sessions,active_projects}, this_week_completed, this_month_completed, trend_pct, avg_completion_time_hours, most_productive_day, most_productive_hour, weekly_series(7), trend_series(30), status_distribution(3), priority_distribution(3), recent_activity(<=10), insights(list)
Analytics numbers: fresh dataset of 2 completed + 1 overdue -> total=3, completed=2, overdue=1, pending=0, completion_rate=66.7
Overdue derivation: completed task with past due_date NOT counted as overdue
Isolation: nora and ahmed lists disjoint; PATCH/DELETE on other user's task -> 404
Regression: /api/, /api/me/stats, /api/memory all still pass; full backend suite 66/66
UI: admin -> productivity-dashboard visible with 6 stat cards (Total=5, Completed=3, Pending=1, Overdue=1, Rate=60%, AI=0)
UI: smart-insights renders auto-generated bullets; quick-actions has all 4 CTAs; chart-weekly/status/trend/priority + productivity-meta + recent-activity all mount
UI: nav-tasks -> tasks-tab; new-task-btn opens task-form; task-title-input + save-task-btn creates task; new row appears immediately
UI: toggle-<id> marks row completed with line-through/opacity
UI: delete-task-<id> removes row from list
UI: navigate back to nav-dashboard re-renders productivity-dashboard with updated totals
UI: all 6 tabs (dashboard/tasks/knowledge/employees/settings/automations/feedback) navigate without error
UI: sarah@technova.com -> /chat; employee-chat renders; submit-leave-request-btn and submit-it-support-btn fire POST /api/webhooks/leave-request and /api/webhooks/it-support respectively
UI: /api/chat/stream still streams; ai-memory-btn opens ai-memory-popover with facts
seed_data_creation: Tests cleanup + recreate tasks for nora and ahmed inside the test module (all prefixed TEST_) and delete them in test_zzz_cleanup. Admin's 5 seeded tasks were left intact.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py Tasks endpoints look clean: per-user filter on every read/patch/delete via {user_id: user['id']}; ObjectId excluded via {'_id':0}; derived overdue is server-computed, not client-supplied. Good.
Route order: GET /tasks/analytics is registered AFTER PATCH /tasks/{task_id} but they use different HTTP methods so no collision. Verified working.
server.py is now ~1116 lines — well past the 700-line threshold. Recommend splitting into routers (auth.py, chat.py, tasks.py, webhooks.py, admin.py) for maintainability before adding more features.
analytics endpoint scans all tasks with .to_list(2000) into memory then re-iterates ~10 times. Works fine for MVP but consider MongoDB aggregation pipelines for larger datasets.

AdminDashboard.jsx also ~1084 lines and contains: main layout, DashboardHome, TasksTab, KnowledgeTab, EmployeesTab, SettingsTab, AutomationsTab, FeedbackTab + helper components (StatCard, QuickAction, MetaRow, TrendBadge, ActivityIcon, DashboardSkeleton, EmptyState, ErrorState). Recommend splitting into /pages/admin/*.jsx modules.
Recharts ResponsiveContainer initial-mount warning ('width(-1) and height(-1)') fires ~8 times per dashboard load. Charts still render, but wrap parent in a min-h-[280px] div to suppress.
trend_pct calculation: when last_week_completed is 0, returns 100.0 or 0.0 — clean fallback. When both weeks have activity, uses percent change formula. Verified.
Task title stripped to 200 chars, description to 2000, project trimmed. Good defensive validation.

PATCH endpoint's `not v is None` filter means passing null/None cannot clear a field explicitly. Setting completed_at back to null on status='pending' is handled manually, but if the user ever needs to clear due_date/project, PATCH cannot do it today. Minor UX gap, not a bug per spec.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test files: test_auth_session.py, test_personalization.py, test_webhooks_prod.py, test_tasks.py — run all with `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v` (66 tests, ~30s). Task tests use module-scoped tokens for nora and ahmed and dynamically set pytest.nora_task_id; if pytest-xdist re-orders, ordering inside a class is still preserved. Frontend testids to know for future admin Tasks/dashboard work: nav-tasks, productivity-dashboard, stat-total/completed/pending/overdue/rate/ai, smart-insights, quick-actions, qa-create-task/qa-open-chat/qa-upload/qa-automations, chart-weekly/status/trend/priority, productivity-meta, recent-activity, dashboard-empty, tasks-tab, new-task-btn, task-form, task-title-input, save-task-btn, toggle-<id>, delete-task-<id>. Admin has 5 seeded tasks left in place.
